core_obligations: Statement (lines 3232-3236): if U is an m-truncated simplicial set and n > m, every n-simplex of i_{m!}U is degenerate.

Verification (proof lines 3238-3249): let V = i_{m!}U and let V' be the subobject equal to V in degrees at most m with all higher simplices degenerate, of Lemma lemma-simplicial-set-n-skel-sub; since sk_m V' = U, the adjunction formula provides a map V' -> V inverse to the inclusion up to the counit, forcing V' = V.
proof_roadmap: Construct V' as the generated subobject of Lemma lemma-simplicial-set-n-skel-sub.
Use the adjunction i_{m!} -| sk_m on the identity of sk_m V'.
Conclude the inclusion V' into V is an isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: Degeneracy vanishing (statement 3232-3236, proof 3238-3249): the adjunction argument is precise - V' is built by the cited lemma, sk_m V' = U by construction, and the adjunction transpose of the identity exhibits the retraction; the counit computation is the standard two-line unroll. H3.
